title: Livelock via Uncoordinated Retry Backoff
pattern: Multiple threads attempt to acquire multiple resources via lock-free or try-lock loops, and upon failure, sleep or backoff by a deterministic, identical duration.
why_bad: Threads will lockstep, repeating the collision and backoff cycles in resonance indefinitely (livelock), wasting CPU cycles without making forward progress.
detection: A retry loop using deterministic backoff intervals (constants) across competing tasks without random jitter.
counterexample: Adding randomized jitter to the backoff interval to break the lockstep resonance.
